title: Bacterial responses to Ephedra aphylla stem extract and green-synthesized Ag-TiO2 and Ag-SeO2 core/shell nanocomposites: unveiling antimicrobial and antioxidant properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13152-13171
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00936G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mahmood Razzaq Mashar Askar
This study reports a green method for synthesizing Ag-TiO2 and Ag-SeO2 NCs using Ephedra aphylla stem extract. The nanocomposites exhibited significant antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
